regime_context: The detector shows a narrow defensive/healthcare leadership structure: Big Pharma is the headline with full breadth (1.0) and high durability (0.84) plus elevated crowding (z=1.46), set against a broad AI/semi meltdown — the momentum leader 'Memory, HBM & Storage' has zero breadth and is ineligible, while nearly every AI/semi theme sits at the bottom of the rank and ineligible. Rotation breadth is narrowing (eligible frac 0.39) and absorption is low (0.32), so this is a defensive, trend-confirmed regime in healthcare/staples, not a broad risk-on tape. Given track_record dir_accuracy of 0.413 on 138 calls, I keep conviction low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching Big Pharma as a potential fading-leadership handoff: if PPH breadth drops below 0.7 and its durability_bar falls below 0.6 while the theme stays eligible, that would signal the defensive leadership is rolling over; I would retire this watch on a confirmed breadth re-expansion above 0.9 with no eligibility loss.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only theme here that is both trend-gate eligible (absolute-trend gate = the one validated risk-control leg) and holding full breadth with high durability (0.84) and a 'trend' Hurst tag. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, but combined with durability and breadth the structure reads as a resilient, still-led trend rather than a blow-off. Crowding (z=1.46) is a size-down caution only, not a fade signal, per guardrails.
theses.dissent: Crowding plus 'confirming' val_state could mark a late-stage consensus; if absolute momentum stalls, a crowded leader with zero marginal buyers can air-pocket even without rotation into a new leader.

falsifier.text: PPH loses its positive absolute trend (drops below its own rising 50-day equivalent) and lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples EW is trend-gate eligible with high durability (0.80), broad participation (breadth 0.879), and the strongest crowding_z in the set (1.89) — a sign of crowded, defensive money parked there, not a sell signal. As the most defensive of the eligible sectors it fits the narrow-defensive regime and benefits from the same validated trend-gate risk control as Big Pharma.
theses.dissent: Elevated crowding with a 'trend' tag can mean the move is fully priced; staples tend to underperform quickly if macro risk appetite re-emerges and money rotates out of defensives into cyclical laggards.

falsifier.text: XLP breaks below its own rising trend baseline and underperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Defensives
theses.thesis: Defensives (consumer defensive + utilities mix) is eligible with very high durability (0.82) and broad breadth (0.944), consistent with the market's defensive-leadership regime. This is an unscorable theme (no single proxy) so conviction is low, but the trend-gate leg is the validated one and it is clearly on.
theses.dissent: The unscorable proxy makes grading the call unreliable, and broad defensives can be dragged down by rate-sensitive utilities if yields rise sharply.

falsifier.text: Both XLP and XLU fall below their rising trend baselines and lag SPY by 5% before the check-by date
